title: RELEASE card frontmatter
description: A version milestone — the theme and intent of a release, plus migration/upgrade notes. NOT a changelog: what shipped is git's job (tags, diff_plan); never enumerate commits or card changes here. FEATURE cards point at a release via their release: field.

version.description: The version string, e.g. 1.1.0. The handle stays the identity (RELEASE-V1-1-0); this is the exact display form.
